subject.title: 飞书话题群(Topic Group)被识别为p2p导致消息路由错误

question: Which Feishu/Lark signal should OpenClaw accept as proof that a `p2p` event is actually a topic/OpenChat group before dispatch and mention routing treat it as group?
rationale: Current source reproduces the bug, but current tests and prior history protect real p2p and warn against a broad `oc_`, `root_id`, or `thread_id` rule without maintainer intent or live/API proof.

options.title: Verify shared discriminator
options.body: Confirm the Feishu/Lark contract or live event shape, then implement one shared Feishu helper for dispatch and mention-forward routing with p2p regression coverage.

options.title: Adopt candidate PR work
options.body: Repair or sponsor an existing candidate only if it proves the same discriminator and preserves current p2p direct/thread invariants.

options.title: Hold for stronger proof
options.body: Keep all `p2p` events direct until a reporter or maintainer supplies definitive Feishu/Lark topic-group evidence.

recommendation.title: Verify shared discriminator
recommendation.body: Confirm the Feishu/Lark contract or live event shape, then implement one shared Feishu helper for dispatch and mention-forward routing with p2p regression coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent topic-session classifier work in bb5e278f63bd makes this the closest available owner signal for the discriminator decision.
